title: Starting parked vehicle.
bodyText: No person shall start a vehicle which is stopped, standing, or parked unless and until such movement can be made with reasonable safety.
bodyHtml: [§291C-83]  Starting parked vehicle.  No person shall start a vehicle which is stopped, standing, or parked unless and until such movement can be made with reasonable safety. [L 1971, c 150, pt of §1]
